_meta.name: poisson_glm
_meta.description: Poisson regression: REG_GLM with family=poisson + link=log models a count-like outcome whose conditional mean grows multiplicatively with the predictors. Sibling family to logistic regression (04_logistic.json, binomial+logit) — both are GLM links; the Poisson+log pair is the canonical choice for non-negative integer counts (event counts, frequencies, claim rates). Uses customers.pulse age as a small-integer outcome with income as the multiplicative predictor — the canonical Poisson interpretation is 'how does the expected count of years scale with one's income?'.
